problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Package Alpha: volume 43 cubic meters
* Package Bravo: volume 64 cubic meters
* Package Charlie: volume 46 cubic meters
* Package Delta: volume 52 cubic meters
* Package Echo: volume 70 cubic meters
* Package Foxtrot: volume 52 cubic meters
* Package Golf: volume 46 cubic meters
* Package Hotel: volume 62 cubic meters
* Package India: volume 30 cubic meters
* Package Juliet: volume 63 cubic meters
* Package Kilo: volume 34 cubic meters
* Package Lima: volume 56 cubic meters
* Package Mike: volume 37 cubic meters
* Package November: volume 66 cubic meters
* Package Oscar: volume 56 cubic meters
* Package Papa: volume 59 cubic meters
* Package Quebec: volume 34 cubic meters
* Package Romeo: volume 36 cubic meters
* Package Sierra: volume 59 cubic meters
* Package Tango: volume 70 cubic meters
* Package Uniform: volume 39 cubic meters
* Package Victor: volume 54 cubic meters
* Package Whiskey: volume 41 cubic meters
* Package X-ray: volume 56 cubic meters
* Package Yankee: volume 65 cubic meters
* Package Zulu: volume 32 cubic meters
* Package Asterisk: volume 52 cubic meters
* Package Backslash: volume 57 cubic meters
* Package Bracket: volume 47 cubic meters
* Package Caret: volume 48 cubic meters
* Package Underscore: volume 39 cubic meters
* Package Grave: volume 35 cubic meters
* Package Alpha2: volume 70 cubic meters
* Package Bravo2: volume 66 cubic meters
* Package Charlie2: volume 58 cubic meters

Each cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes possible. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity limit.
